name: Roaring River State Park Campgrounds
description: Three campgrounds with basic and hookup camping near Roaring River. Map pin represents Campground 1; follow reservation instructions for your assigned loop.
seasonal_notes: Campground 1 operates year-round; campgrounds 2 and 3 operate February 25 through October 31. Check official advisories before arrival.

name: Table Rock State Park Campgrounds
description: Two campgrounds on Table Rock Lake with basic and hookup sites. Map pin represents Campground 1; follow reservation instructions for your assigned loop.
seasonal_notes: Camping is available year-round; water and shower services vary in winter. Gates close at 10 p.m.

name: Devil's Den State Park Campground
description: Tent and hookup camping in Lee Creek Valley near Lake Devil. Map pin represents camping Area E. Register at the visitor center before occupying a campsite.
seasonal_notes: Campground open year-round. Contact the park for horse-camp reservations.

name: Bull Shoals-White River State Park Campground
description: Tent and hookup camping beside the White River below Bull Shoals Dam. The camping entrance is in Lakeview, separate from the visitor center. Map pin represents the riverside campground, not the visitor center.
seasonal_notes: Campground open year-round; bathhouses operate March through November.
